name: libro-interactivo
description: Libro Interactivo (universo Memorias): web, API y paquetes compartidos

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm test --workspaces --if-present
